id: -703-辛那赫里布對巴比倫的戰爭
theater: 美索不達米亞中游幼發拉底河兩岸

battle.name: 辛那赫里布對巴比倫的戰爭
battle.theater: 美索不達米亞中游幼發拉底河兩岸
battle.brief: 前七〇三年，亞述王辛那赫里布在阿舒爾集兵，鎮壓巴比倫與埃蘭的聯軍：先在基什方向受挫，隨後集中全軍攻破庫特哈屯軍，再取基什之勝，逼得叛王馬爾杜克－阿普拉－伊迪納出走。巴比倫不戰而降，辛那赫里布改立傀儡王貝爾－伊布尼。卡面的亞述長矛，正是這支大軍手中最靠前的近戰骨幹。

kit.name: 亞述長矛
kit.history: 短柄、長刃，配著鐵鏃。亞述人把它和弓、鐵器綁在一起，兩河流域的城一個接一個陷落。

countries: 這場戰爭的交戰方，一邊是新亞述帝國，另一邊是以巴比倫城為核心、由迦勒底部落與阿姆哈爾邊民武裝組成的南方聯盟，埃蘭王國以同盟者身分出兵。地點在美索不達米亞中游的幼發拉底河兩岸與底格里斯河中游，核心是巴比倫、基什、庫特哈三處，以及埃蘭軍越過的扎布河一線。亞述方由辛那赫里布直接統帥，薩爾貢王朝的常備軍為骨幹，各省城邦按額徵召步兵、弓手、投石手、戰車與役畜，阿舒爾是南方戰役的集結點與補給基地，戰場指揮由亞述主帥擔任，另有書吏與占卜官隨軍記錄戰況。巴比倫方則由迦勒底首領馬爾杜克－阿普拉－伊迪納整合城邦住民與部落軍，聘請埃蘭王國的步兵與馬兵參戰，把大軍分屯於基什與庫特哈，以城池為堡壘、以遊擊隊遲滯亞述遠征軍。埃蘭本身是伊朗西南部的強國，長期與巴比倫爭奪蘇薩，願意出兵干預以牽制亞述。整體而言，這不是亞述對一個統一國家的戰爭，而是帝國對一個內部三分、又有外援的鬆散聯盟的戰爭；亞述最終沒有消滅巴比倫，而是把它重新收編為附庸。
countriesEn: The belligerents in this war were the Neo-Assyrian Empire on one side and, on the other, a southern coalition centred on the city of Babylon, raised from the Chaldean tribes and the Aramean fringes, with the kingdom of Elam entering the war as an allied state. The fighting took place in the middle Euphrates and middle Tigrates corridors of Mesopotamia, with the decisive points at Babylon, Kish and Kutha, and along the line of the Zab (Ḥaḏa) river crossed by the Elamite army. On the Assyrian side Sennacherib commanded in person; the standing army of the Sargonid dynasty formed the core, supplemented by infantry, archers, slingers, chariots and draught animals levied from the provincial cities, with Assur serving as the mustering and supply base for southern campaigns, the field command entrusted to the Assyrian commander-in-chief, and scribes and diviners travelling with the army to record what happened. On the Babylonian side the Chaldean chieftain Marduk-apla-iddina I mobilised the city-dwellers of Babylon together with the tribal contingents, hired troops from Elam, and entrenched his main body at Kish and Kutha, using the fortified cities as strongpoints and roving bands to delay the Assyrian column. Elam itself was a power in south-western Iran that had long contested Susa with Babylon and was glad to intervene in order to pin the Assyrians down in the south. The war was therefore not a campaign against a unified state but against a loosely knit coalition that was divided three ways and had outside help; Assyria did not destroy Babylon, it took it back into the system of tributaries.
people: 辛那赫里布是這場戰爭的關鍵人物。他是薩爾貢二世的次子，名字意為月神辛取代了兄弟，暗示他並非長子而諸兄皆已先亡；前七〇五年即位時，他沒有舉行阿舒爾傳統的即位禮，而是把首都從尼姆魯德遷到尼尼微，營造無雙之宮。他即位後放棄前人自稱巴比倫代王的做法，公開以巴比倫之王自居，又拒絕舉行握瑪爾杜克之手的加冕禮，這個舉動正是南方起義的直接導火線。叛方領袖馬爾杜克－阿普拉－伊迪納一世是迦勒底首領，薩爾貢二世在位時他曾一度奪取巴比倫之權而被打敗，前七〇三年他再度奪王位，兩三週內廢掉馬爾杜克－扎基爾－舒米二世，並整合城邦住民與迦勒底部落軍，聘埃蘭兵，屯兵基什與庫特哈，戰敗後退往埃蘭；巴比倫編年史記他被埃蘭人捉住後以矛刺殺。辛那赫里布任命的巴比倫王阿舒爾－那丁－舒姆一世在起義中被俘；辛那赫里布的長子阿舒爾－那丁－舒姆二世則在前六九四年的另一次遠征中遇害，成為王位繼承的隱憂。埃蘭王圖曼是聯軍最關鍵的外援。最後被扶上王位的是在亞述宮中長大的巴比倫人貝爾－伊布尼。亞述銘文另提到一名被俘者是叛首的繼子、阿拉伯女王雅提的兄弟。
peopleEn: Sennacherib is the decisive figure in this war. He was the second son of Sargon II; his name means that Sin has replaced the brothers, implying that he was not the firstborn and that his elder brothers had all died young. On his accession in 705 BC he skipped the traditional coronation at Assur and instead moved the capital from Nimrud to Nineveh, where he raised the Palace without Rival. He abandoned his predecessors' practice of styling himself viceroy of Babylon, claimed outright the title of king of Babylon, and refused the rite of taking the hand of the statue of Marduk. That gesture was the immediate spark of the revolt in the south. The leader of the rebels, Marduk-apla-iddina I, was a Chaldean chief who had already seized Babylon once under Sargon II and been driven out; in 703 BC he seized the throne again, deposed Marduk-zakir-shumi II within two or four weeks, and united the city-dwellers with Chaldean tribal troops while hiring soldiers from Elam and massing at Kish and Kutha; after his defeat he withdrew towards Elam, and the Babylonian Chronicle records that he was taken by the Elamites and killed with a spear. Aššur-nādin-šum I, the king of Babylon appointed by Sennacherib, was captured in the uprising. Sennacherib's eldest son, Aššur-nādin-šum II, was killed during the later campaign of 694 BC, which turned the question of succession into a standing danger. The Elamite king Teumman was the decisive external ally. The man finally set on the throne of Babylon was Bel-ibni, a Babylonian raised in the Assyrian palace. Sennacherib's inscriptions also record a captive who was the stepson of the rebel king and a brother of the Arab queen Yatie.
kits: 卡面的亞述長矛是這場戰爭裡亞述軍隊的近戰骨幹。短柄、長刃，鐵鏃插在木柄上，矛線在亞述步兵編制中位於最前，負責接戰與封鎖缺口，弓手與投石手在後列陣支援。亞述步軍的標準配置是矛、弓、投石索三者並行：長矛用於短兵相接、壓住城門缺口，弓與投石索負責在遠程削弱對手，箭鏃與投石同為鐵製。步兵另備斧與短刀，盾有圓形與長形兩式，鎧甲以鐵片與青銅片綴成鱗甲，頭盔有尖頂與冠飾，箭袋與箭匣隨身攜帶。攻城時同一批矛手與工兵一同作業，撞槌、攻城塔、斜坡與土壘把城牆壓垮，長桿、鐵鎬與斧用來清除城頭守備。亞述輕型戰車多配雙馬或三馬，主要給王族、傳令與偵察使用，步兵則靠牛車與役畜自運糧秣，並沿底格里斯河與幼發拉底河用船隊輸送。巴比倫與埃蘭方面以夯土城牆與塔樓守城，聯軍裝備以步兵、弓手為主，埃蘭軍自東面越過扎布河而來，另有車兵與馬兵。辛那赫里布的銘文記南方平定役中俘虜逾二十萬，這批人由亞述隊伍押走遷徙，可見遠征軍除武器外還要攜帶大量糧秣、繩索與看守的人手。
kitsEn: The Assyrian spear on the card is the close-combat backbone of the Assyrian army in this war. Short in the shaft and long in the blade, with an iron head socketed into the wood, the spear stood at the front of the Assyrian infantry line, where it met the enemy and held the gaps, while archers and slingers supported from the ranks behind. The standard load of an Assyrian infantryman was spear, bow and sling in combination: the long shaft for the close fight and for sealing a breach in a gate, the bow and the sling to wear the enemy down at range, with iron arrowheads and iron sling stones. Infantry also carried the axe and short sword, and wore round or tall shields, scale armour of iron and bronze plate, and helmets with pointed crowns and crests, with quivers and arrow cases carried on the person. In siege work the same spearmen worked alongside the engineers: battering rams, siege towers, ramps and embankments brought the wall down, while long poles, iron picks and axes cleared the defenders from the ramparts. Assyrian light chariots were drawn by two or three horses and served the royal family, couriers and scouts, while the foot soldiers relied on ox-drawn wagons and pack animals and moved grain and fodder by boat along the Tigrates and Euphrates. The Babylonian and Elamite side defended with mud-brick walls and towers; the coalition was chiefly infantry and archers, the Elamite army arriving from the east across the Zab, with chariot and horse contingents besides. Sennacherib's inscriptions record more than two hundred thousand captives taken in the southern pacification, marched off and resettled by Assyrian columns, which shows that a marching army carried not only weapons but also enormous quantities of grain, rope and the manpower needed to guard the prisoners.
tactics: 亞述的戰術可以分成集結、分進與掃蕩三段。前七〇四年部分兵馬遠征塔巴爾，辛那赫里布擔心兩線作戰而按兵不動，叛軍因此得以從容集結，這是本場戰爭最關鍵的時間差。前七〇三年遠征結束，他先在阿舒爾集結大軍再南下，選擇以幼發拉底河中游的走廊為主軸。第一次接觸是在基什方向失利，亞述軍攻擊聯軍屯兵未果，反而替對手壯了聲勢；辛那赫里布隨即改變打法，看出聯軍分屯兩處、兵力分散，便集中全軍先攻庫特哈一處，攻破其營壘，再回師攻基什，第二次接觸得勝，此時叛首已先行遁走。得手後他徑直進軍巴比倫城下，該城不戰而開城迎降，只受一次輕微劫掠與譴責，城市祭祀區與宮殿大致保存。短暫休整之後，他不再依賴一次會戰，而是以分遣隊與連續推進逐城掃蕩南巴比倫，把仍在抵抗的城邑與部落地區逐一平定，再以遷徙與改編收束。作戰層面上，亞述步兵以密集縱隊行軍，矛線在前、弓箭在後，戰車用於偵察與聯絡，攻城則集中撞槌與工兵；守方則以城防固守與遊擊遲滯相配合，寄望拖長亞述的補給線。
tacticsEn: The Assyrian method in this campaign can be divided into mustering, concentration and mopping-up. In 704 BC part of the army was away in Tabal, and Sennacherib, unwilling to fight on two fronts, waited; the rebels used that delay to complete their mobilisation, and it was the most consequential factor in the war. In 703 BC, with the Tabal expedition finished, he concentrated the army at Assur and moved south, choosing the middle Euphrates corridor as his axis. The first contact went badly at Kish, where the Assyrians failed to break the coalition's entrenched force and in effect strengthened the rebel cause. Sennacherib then changed his method: seeing that the coalition was split between two camps and dispersed, he threw the whole army at Kutha first, broke that encampment, and turned back on Kish to win the second engagement, by which time the rebel king had already fled. He then marched straight on Babylon, which opened its gates and surrendered without a fight, suffering only a light sack and a reprimand, with the cult quarter and the palaces largely preserved. After a short rest he no longer relied on a single pitched engagement, but worked with detached columns and continuous advance, clearing the cities of southern Babylonia one by one, first those still resisting and then the tribal districts, and closed the operation with transfers and reorganisation. At the tactical level the Assyrian infantry marched in dense columns with the spear line in front and the bow and sling behind; chariots were used for scouting and for liaison; sieges were run by concentrated rams with engineers attached. The defence answered with fortified positions and delaying skirmishing, hoping to stretch out the Assyrian lines of supply.
data: 時間線上有幾個可核對的節點：辛那赫里布前七〇五年即位，前七〇四年率軍遠征塔巴爾並在南方引發起義，南方兩次反亂相隔約一個月，前七〇三年亞述軍在阿舒爾集結南下。巴比倫編年史把捕捉巴比倫國王一事繫於巴比倫曆塔穆茲月，約當公曆七至八月，因此本卡戰爭的起始月取七月。叛方更替的時間很短：馬爾杜克－扎基爾－舒米二世在位數週即被廢，馬爾杜克－阿普拉－伊迪納自前七〇三年起掌權，直到前六九四年才被亞述追擊至拉什並戰死，統治約九年。距離方面，阿舒爾與巴比倫直線約三百五十公里，循河谷繞行更遠；巴比倫到基什約十五至二十公里，庫特哈在巴比倫以北約七十公里的幼發拉底河東岸；埃蘭軍越過的扎布河在底格里斯河中游以東、今伊拉克與伊朗邊界一帶。人數方面，辛那赫里布的銘文沒有留下這支遠征軍的確切編制，現存材料只能說大軍以萬計，學界多作數萬量級的保守估計。唯一明確的大數字是戰果：銘文記南方平定役中俘虜逾二十萬。亞述銘文另記一名被俘者是叛首的繼子、阿拉伯女王雅提的兄弟。
dataEn: A few points in the chronology can be checked against the sources. Sennacherib acceded in 705 BC; in 704 BC he campaigned in Tabal and the revolt in the south broke out; the two southern risings were about a month apart; in 703 BC the Assyrian army mustered at Assur and moved south. The Babylonian Chronicle ties the capture of the king of Babylon to the Babylonian month of Tammuz, which corresponds to about July or August, so July is taken here as the opening month of the war. The changes of ruler in the rebel camp were rapid: Marduk-zakir-shumi II reigned for only a few weeks before being deposed, while Marduk-apla-iddina held power from 703 BC until 694 BC, when he was run down at Lashar and killed, giving him about nine years of rule. As for distances, Assur and Babylon lie roughly three hundred and fifty kilometres apart in a straight line and considerably further when the river route is followed; Kish is some fifteen to twenty kilometres from Babylon; Kutha stands on the east bank of the Euphrates about seventy kilometres north of Babylon; and the Zab crossed by the Elamite army lies east of the middle Tigrates, along the modern Iraqi-Iranian border. On numbers of men, Sennacherib's inscriptions give no exact establishment for this field army; the surviving material can only say that the host was counted in tens of thousands, and scholars generally work with a conservative estimate on that order. The one firm large figure is the result: the inscriptions record more than two hundred thousand captives in the southern pacification, and also a captive who was the stepson of the rebel king and a brother of the Arab queen Yatie.
cause: 起義的直接原因在制度層面。巴比倫人視瑪爾杜克為巴比倫城的真正國王，因此自阿卡德時代起，執掌巴比倫的亞述總督只以代王自居，舉行加冕禮時要握瑪爾杜克神像之手。辛那赫里布即位後改弦更張，公開自稱巴比倫之王並略去這套禮節，南方視之為對城市神權與傳統王權的褻瀆，兩次反亂因此接連爆發。更深的根源是巴比倫本身的結構性弱點：城邦巴比倫人、迦勒底部落首領與阿姆哈爾遊牧者三方互相爭鬥，中央權威脆弱，薩爾貢二世晚年雖以阿舒爾－那丁－舒姆一世為傀儡維持局面，那位迦勒底首領卻一直覬覦復辟。外交上，馬爾杜克－阿普拉－伊迪納向埃蘭求援，埃蘭王圖曼正樂見巴比倫與亞述相鬥，於是聯軍從東面壓上，使亞述被迫在南方與西方同時應付。亞述自身的失誤也不可忽視：兵馬遠在塔巴爾之際仍按兵不動，等於默許叛軍完成集結，讓這場原本可能速戰速決的戰爭拖成漫長的遠征消耗。
causeEn: The immediate cause of the revolt lay in a matter of ritual and sovereignty. The Babylonians held that Marduk was the true king of the city, so ever since the Akkadian period the Assyrian governor of Babylon had styled himself a viceroy and had taken the hand of the statue of Marduk at his coronation. Sennacherib changed this: he claimed outright the title of king of Babylon and left the rite out, and the south read the omission as an affront to the city's divine kingship, so the risings broke out one after another. Deeper still lay the structural weakness of Babylonia: city-dwellers, Chaldean chiefs and nomadic Arameans were all quarrelling with one another, and central authority was brittle. Sargon II had held things together with the puppet Aššur-nādin-šum I, but the dispossessed Chaldean leader never stopped scheming to come back. Diplomatically, Marduk-apla-iddina appealed to Elam, and the Elamite king Teumman, glad to see Babylon and Assyria weaken each other, sent his forces to press from the east, forcing Assyria to answer in the south and the west at once. Assyrian misjudgement also mattered: the army was away in Tabal and yet no move was made, which was in effect permission for the rebels to finish gathering, and turned a campaign that might have been decided in a single season into a long and costly march.
impact: 這場戰爭的影響，最直接的一層是亞述南方統治模式的重新設計。辛那赫里布在巴比倫放棄了前朝王兼任巴比倫之王的做法，改為以在宮中長大的巴比倫人貝爾－伊布尼為附庸王，自己保留巴比倫之王的頭銜而把日常治理交給本地王朝。這套雙軌體制維持到前六九四年，其間巴比倫的祭祀傳統、神廟經濟與書吏制度都得以延續，讓亞述避開了直接佔領的昂貴代價，而代價在後來一次又一次被追加。戰爭同時把南方反亂的效應傳到西線，辛那赫里布在前七〇一年的黎凡特戰役中要同時對付西頓、推羅與猶大，兵力的分佈正源於此。更深遠的後果在前六九四年：辛那赫里布再率大軍直取巴比倫，摧毀神廟、掠走瑪爾杜克神像，同一次遠征中他的長子阿舒爾－那丁－舒姆二世在尼尼微遇害，繼承問題浮上檯面；前六八九年他終於拆毀巴比倫城，前六二六年亞述帝國崩潰後，這片廢墟才在新巴比倫帝國的手上開始重建。對軍事學而言，本役示範的以全軍攻其分兵、破一點再掃全區的作戰法，也成為亞述戰爭法的樣板。
impactEn: The most direct effect of this war was a redesign of how Assyria ruled the south. Sennacherib gave up the older practice of the king doubling as king of Babylon, and instead set Bel-ibni, a Babylonian raised in the royal palace, as a tributary king, keeping the title of king of Babylon for himself while handing daily government to a native line. That two-track arrangement held until 694 BC, and in the interval the cult traditions, temple economy and scribal institutions of Babylon were preserved, sparing Assyria the cost of a direct occupation, a cost that was later added again and again. The revolt in the south also pushed disturbance westwards: in the Levantine campaign of 701 BC Sennacherib had to deal at once with Sidon, Tyre and Judah, and the distribution of his forces sprang from that southern entanglement. The deeper consequences arrive in 694 BC, when Sennacherib marched on Babylon once more, wrecked the temples and carried off the statue of Marduk, and in the same expedition his eldest son Aššur-nādin-šum II was murdered at Nineveh, bringing the succession to the front of affairs; in 689 BC he finally razed the city, and only after the Assyrian empire collapsed in 626 BC was the ruin rebuilt as a great city of the Neo-Babylonian state. In military terms the campaign supplied a model of Assyrian method: concentrate everything against one part of a divided enemy, break it, then sweep the whole region.
result: 前七〇三年這場戰爭的直接結果，是亞述重新取得對巴比倫的支配。基什方向首戰失利之後，辛那赫里布改為集中全軍先破庫特哈屯軍，再取基什之勝，叛首馬爾杜克－阿普拉－伊迪納在接戰前已先行遁走。巴比倫城不戰而降，只受一次輕微劫掠，城市主體與神廟未遭毀滅，亞述因此得以在不大破巴比倫的前提下達成戰役目的。辛那赫里布隨後以分遣隊掃蕩南巴比倫各城與部落地區，銘文記俘虜逾二十萬，並以大規模遷徙與改編削弱當地抵抗力量。政治安排上，迦勒底人的統治被廢，貝爾－伊布尼被立為附庸王，巴比倫自此進入一段相對順從的時期，直到前六九四年再度起義。但真正的清算來得很遲：前六九四年辛那赫里布親征巴比倫，摧毀城邑、掠走瑪爾杜克神像，前六八九年更把整座城拆毀。巴比倫自此衰敗，直到新巴比倫王朝崛起才重新成為兩河流域的核心城市。
resultEn: The immediate outcome of the campaign of 703 BC was the recovery of Babylon by Assyria. After the reverse at Kish, Sennacherib concentrated the whole army on the camp at Kutha, broke it, and then won at Kish, while the rebel king Marduk-apla-iddina had already slipped away before the engagement. Babylon surrendered without a fight and suffered only a light sack; the substance of the city and its temples were not destroyed, and so Assyria reached its purpose without razing Babylon. Sennacherib then swept the cities and tribal districts of southern Babylonia with detached columns; the inscriptions record more than two hundred thousand captives, and large-scale transfers and reorganisation weakened local resistance. Politically, Chaldean rule was abolished and Bel-ibni was installed as a tributary king, and Babylonia entered a period of comparative obedience that lasted until the revolt of 694 BC. But the real reckoning came late: in 694 BC Sennacherib campaigned in person against Babylon, wrecked the city and carried off the statue of Marduk, and in 689 BC he razed the whole place. Babylon declined from that point, and it was not until the rise of the Neo-Babylonian dynasty that it became once again the central city of the two rivers.
